description: A LoadReport object represents the value for a single load variable on a specific host.

attributes.name: name
description: Name of the load variable. In order for the load value to be processed in sge_qmaster
a complex variable with this name must have been configured.

attributes.name: value
description: Value of the variable on a specific host.

attributes.name: global
description: Specifies if it is a global load variable.
1 means that it is a global load value (host is global in this case),
0 means that it is a host specific load value.

attributes.name: is_static
description: Specifies if it is a static load variable.
Static load variables represent seldomly changing variables, e.g. arch, n_proc, mem_total.
0 means a non static load value
2 is a special internal value: remove the load value

attributes.name: host
description: Name of the host on which the load value is valid. Specific host name or keyword global for global load values.
